integrity: The proof is analytic: a four-secant inequality bounds every Akima derivative by half of the local total variation, the uniform-grid telescoping bound converts this to M/(2h), and the cubic Hermite basis gives the exact range envelope. A rational family establishes sharpness and the packaged checker replays all finite algebra.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the original one-dimensional Akima rule on a uniform grid and for interior segments. It does not cover modified Akima variants, monotonicity limiters, nonuniform grids, endpoint extrapolation rules, or higher-dimensional extensions. The sharp constants are infimum/supremum values over the admissible class rather than values attained by one finite nondegenerate configuration.
title: The uniform Akima interpolant has sharp monotone range defect \(2/27\)
